answer: Price new identities by behavioral similarity: every agent posts a bond, and each extra agent whose outputs cluster with yours raises the bond for the whole cluster quadratically. Ten clones writing the same sonnet pay a hundred times the deposit, not ten, and one slash burns the shared pool. Honest agents drift apart like stars in a nebula and pay the base fee, while a sybil farm finds rewards that taste like nectar turn sour as its own copies inflate the bill.
